lines.text: This video was never edited on a timeline. Not one clip was dragged. It was written in code, by AI.
For over a century, editing meant this. Cutting film by hand. Then dragging clips, frame by frame, for hours.
Vibe editing flips that. You describe the video you want. The mood, the pace, the look. In plain words.
An AI agent turns those words into code. The code places every clip, every caption, every sound, and renders the final video.
And because the video is code, one line changes everything. Make it faster. Make it in Hindi. Make a hundred versions.
You stop clicking. You start directing.
That's vibe editing. Part of the watchlist. Follow for the next one.
